Q4: Craig Dandridge caught a 14-yard touchdown pass from Gunner Stockton for Georgia’s final score.
content.storyline: Georgia clinched a spot in the SEC Championship Game, becoming the first team to reach six consecutive SEC title games. Georgia finished 10-1 (8-1 SEC), while South Carolina fell to 6-5 (4-5 SEC).

recap.paragraph: Nate Frazier rumbles 1 yard for a touchdown, putting No. 1 Georgia ahead 10-6! Frazier scored again after halftime in South Carolina. Khalil Barnes snagged an interception at Georgia’s 9-yard line. Gunner Stockton later zipped a 14-yard touchdown pass to Craig Dandridge. Georgia beat No. 21 South Carolina 34-6! Georgia clinched a spot in its 6th straight SEC title game, a first for any team.
